SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, c.Currency, SUM(y.Consumption) as TotalConsumption
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' 
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 2013
GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY c.Segment, TotalConsumption ASC
LIMIT 50

SELECT c.Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) as MinConsumption, COUNT(*) as NumCustomersWithMin
FROM (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) as TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' 
      AND CAST(SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 2013
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
) t
JOIN customers c2 ON 1=1
WHERE t.TotalConsumption = (SELECT MIN(t2.TotalConsumption) FROM (
    SELECT c3.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) as TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c3
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c3.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c3.Currency = 'CZK' 
      AND CAST(SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 2013
    GROUP BY c3.CustomerID
) t2 JOIN customers c4 ON t2.CustomerID = c4.CustomerID WHERE c4.Segment = c2.Segment)
GROUP BY c.Segment

WITH CustomerConsumption AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) as TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' 
      AND CAST(SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 2013
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
MinPerSegment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) as MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerConsumption
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT m.Segment, m.MinConsumption, COUNT(*) as NumCustomersWithMin
FROM MinPerSegment m
JOIN CustomerConsumption cc ON m.Segment = cc.Segment AND m.MinConsumption = cc.TotalConsumption
GROUP BY m.Segment, m.MinConsumption

WITH CustomerConsumption AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) as TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' 
      AND CAST(SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 2013
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
MinPerSegment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) as MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerConsumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
AnnualAvg AS (
    SELECT m.Segment, 
           m.MinConsumption * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as AnnualAvgConsumption
    FROM MinPerSegment m
    JOIN CustomerConsumption cc ON m.Segment = cc.Segment AND m.MinConsumption = cc.TotalConsumption
    GROUP BY m.Segment, m.MinConsumption
)
SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END) as SME_minus_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END) as LAM_minus_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END) as KAM_minus_SME
FROM AnnualAvg
